changelog:
• Over-The-Air Update Architecture Overhaul: Fully resolved WinRAR/archive temporary extraction bug; updates automatically redirect to permanent local installation with automatic Desktop shortcut creation and failsafe relaunch
• Native Private GitHub Repository OTA Streaming: Direct streaming integration with GitHub Releases API and chunked SHA-256 verification
• Delta Account Real-Time Trading History: New dedicated Tab 3 in bottom drawer fetching live Order History and Trade Fills from Delta Exchange
• Trading History Interactive Filtering: Filter dynamically between All Orders, Filled Orders, Cancelled Orders, and Executed Fills with cancellation reasons and fee details
• Real-Time Order & Fill Refresh: One-click non-blocking asynchronous sync with Delta Exchange API
• Dynamic Single-Source Versioning: Centralized version management across all UI dialogs, headers, and build pipelines
